entry.title: Vibration patterns and reed - pipe coupling in the free reeds of the hulusi
entry.summary:
The hulusi is a free-reed instrument from Yunnan, Western China, known for its unique sound. Its reed and frame are cut from a single brass sheet in a symmetric shape, the free end narrower than the clamped end. Its free reeds are coupled to tubes that determine the instrument's pitch during normal playing.

Source: arXiv Game Theory, Complex Systems & Soc-Phys (cs.GT, nlin.AO, physics.soc-ph) · Tags: #decision-theory #complex-systems #fluid-dynamics
